summary: Practise prompt design, RAG testing, LLM evaluation, and security controls. Review the five-day intermediate course outline.
lede: Generative AI and large language model (LLM) training helps practitioners build and test LLM-powered applications. It is for engineers, product managers, evaluators, and security practitioners who need to turn application requirements into repeatable checks. Participants practise refining prompts, assessing retrieval sources and response quality, and testing tool-based workflows, while creating risk controls and monitoring plans for application changes.
audienceIntro: This course suits practitioners responsible for specifying, building, evaluating, securing, or maintaining LLM-powered applications and their supporting data workflows.
modules: LLM Use Cases and Acceptance Criteria
OWASP LLM Security and Risk Controls
LLM Release Records and Improvement Plans
prerequisites: Working familiarity with application development, data handling, or machine-learning workflows is expected. Programming is required for hands-on prototype and application-integration exercises; bring working knowledge of one programming language and a notebook environment. No specific language or commercial platform is prescribed.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
